summary.content:
Today's selection covers 86 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 48 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic’s and OpenAI’s Dance With the Pentagon: What to Know
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Termite ransomware breaches linked to ClickFix CastleRAT attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 15 articles published in the last 24 hours
